referenceFunction.includedProcesses: This dataset describes the structure of the Spanish gas mix with regard to the countries of origin and the energy requirements and the emissions of the high pressure distribution network.
referenceFunction.localName: Natural gas, high pressure, at consumer
referenceFunction.name: Natural gas, high pressure, at consumer

geography.text: Energy requirements and emissions are based on Swiss data. Calculations include production and transport of natural gas from 15 countries.

technology.text: The quantity of gas delivered in the high pressure network is estimated. Industry, power plants and half of commercial and of other sectors are assumed to consume high pressure gas.

timePeriod.text: Energy requirements are from 2019 and leakage data are from 2018. Trade movements investigated for 2023.

representativeness.samplingProcedure: Literature. Online calculators for distances.The consumption mix is calculated based on international trade statistics for 2023.
